name: Survey tile in Aquarius
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 0.4 degrees south of the ecliptic in Aquarius, imaged by SPHEREx 13 times in 5 visits over 55 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 26 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 2.3 days starting 2025-12-08, at wavelengths from 0.83 to 4.33 µm. The pipeline found 2 moving objects.
